description: This file defines the I18NImportError class, a Doctrine ORM entity representing import error records related to internationalization (i18n) within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for linked language error data, the employee who imported the error, and relevant getter/setter methods.

classes.name: I18NImportError
classes.description: An ORM entity class representing an import error related to internationalization, with properties for error details, associated language string, language, employee, and related methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the import error record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the import error record.

methods.name: getImportedBy
methods.description: Retrieves the Employee who imported this error.

methods.name: setImportedBy
methods.description: Sets the Employee who imported this error.
